mission_01: Congratulations! You have successfully applied one-hot encoding to categorical variables. You learned how pd.get_dummies() creates binary columns for each category and how drop_first=True avoids multicollinearity by removing the first category column. One-hot encoding is essential for algorithms that cannot handle categorical data directly, such as linear regression, neural networks, and support vector machines. Remember that one-hot encoding can create many columns for high-cardinality features, which may lead to the curse of dimensionality.
